name: Araldite PT 910
description: Araldite PT 910 (CAS 152042-34-7 ) is a multifunctional epoxy resin hardener used to cure and crosslink epoxy systems in high-performance industrial applications. It is recognized in the market as a solid curing agent that delivers elevated thermal and chemical resistance. In electronics, this material is used to formulate encapsulants, potting compounds, and underfill materials where cured systems must maintain dimensional stability under thermal cycling. These applications require high reliability in demanding end-use environments. Aerospace and automotive structural adhesives rely on this hardener to achieve high glass transition temperatures and mechanical strength in bonded assemblies. It ensures that structural components remain secure under significant physical stress. Coating formulators incorporate the product into powder coating systems and high-build protective coatings where resistance to aggressive chemical exposure is required. This makes it ideal for industrial surfaces and heavy-duty machinery protection. Sealant and elastomer manufacturers use it to control rheology and crosslink density in epoxy-based sealant formulations for industrial joints and assemblies. This control is vital for maintaining the integrity of seals over long periods. The product is supplied as a solid, typically in powder or granule form suited for dry-blending with epoxy resins. It is available in technical grade for industrial and specialty formulation use across various manufacturing sectors. Packaging options generally range from kilogram-scale bags to bulk quantities depending on volume requirements.
